### Membership pull requests

- [ ] Request issue linked above
- [ ] Sponsors have commented confirming what they vouch for
- [ ] An organizer verified the baseline: group page, CNCF Slack, WhatsApp
- [ ] Units counted against the current phase threshold
- [ ] No personal phone number, email, Slack handle or WhatsApp name in the diff
- [ ] `uv run scripts/validate_members.py` passes

### Governance changes

- [ ] **Why** states the problem, not just the change
- [ ] Nothing contradicts the CNCF Code of Conduct or the programme rules
- [ ] Strips nobody of a role they hold; if it would, use that role's removal process

Governance changes need two thirds of organizers and a 7-day comment period. Exception: any organizer may merge a fix to a factual error about CNCF policy, a dead link, or committed personal data immediately, with the rationale here.
